description.value: Sushi Bella is a French-Japanese fusion restaurant established on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver in 2010, blending traditional Japanese technique with West Coast and French influences. The menu goes well beyond sushi to include chicken dishes, gyoza, calamari, and crab cakes, making it a welcoming stop for riders who aren't sushi fans. Takeout and delivery via Skip the Dishes are available, offering flexibility for cyclists who want to eat on the go.
